audit.title: Audit log
audit.head: The latest entry: No. {id}, hash {hash}. Keep this line outside the server too (for example at each monthly check) — that way even a deleted end of the chain is caught.

requests.title: Plan orders
requests.how: Orders come from the customer's account and have already been confirmed by email. Send an invoice with the payment details. When the payment arrives, press “Activate”: the plan changes and the order is closed. For a consumer order without an early-start request the paid period can only start after the withdrawal period ends — the panel does not allow it earlier.
requests.planManual: The plan was not returned automatically — check it.
requests.notConfirmed: The email confirmation has not gone out — maintenance keeps trying.

new.title: New account
new.passwordHint: With a password the account is confirmed at once. Without one, the person gets an email to set a password (the link is valid for 1 hour, after that “Forgot password” works); an account that is never set up is deleted after 7 days.

errors.banReason: The reason must be 3 to 500 characters.
errors.confirmEmail: The confirmation email does not match.
errors.emailTaken: There is already an account with this email.
errors.input: A field is filled in incorrectly.
errors.pastDate: The date must be in the future.
errors.rank: You cannot change an account with an equal or higher role.
errors.self: You cannot do this to your own account.
errors.requestGone: The order is no longer open: the customer cancelled it, withdrew from the contract, or it was closed.
errors.withdrawalPeriod: The consumer did not ask for an early start: the paid period can only start after the withdrawal period ends.
errors.orderMismatch: An order is fulfilled only with the plan ordered: Lifetime with Lifetime, Premium with the same number of months.

account.readOnly: You can only view this account: its role is equal to or higher than yours.
account.notStarted: starts when the email is confirmed
account.lifetimeHint: Lifetime has no end date. The list price is {price} excl. VAT.
account.premiumHint: The months are added after the current period ends, if it is still running.
account.notePlaceholder: for example invoice or payment number
account.linkedHint: Other accounts with the same device, the same HWID or the same IP address — a sign of a repeated trial or a shared account. Identical phones give the same HWID, and offices and mobile networks share addresses, so an HWID or IP shared by more than 10 accounts links nobody; a shared IP alone is no proof.
account.banHint: The person sees this reason when trying to sign in. Write clearly and without other people's personal data.
account.banConfirm: Block this account? All its sessions will end.
account.reset2faConfirm: Reset two-factor protection? The person will have to turn it on again.
account.roleConfirm: Change the role? The account's sessions will end.
account.roleHint: The team opens the admin panel only with two-factor protection.
account.deleteText: The account, projects, sessions and devices are deleted permanently. Only a hash of the email stays in the audit log.
account.deleteConfirm: Last check: delete this account for good?
account.orderTerms: Buyer: {buyer}; early start: {early}; the paid period may start from {date} on.
